judged_text: The only spec for the new CRUD controller asserts class inheritance (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController < Admin::AdminController`) and never issues a request, so create/update/destroy and save_host are completely unverified (evidence-of-absence: this diff's only other controller specs are the identical subclass check in embedding_controller_spec.rb and the embed_controller specs, none of which touch this controller). Real defects ship green: `update`/`destroy` with an unknown id (e.g., a second admin deleting from a stale page) hit `save_host(nil)`/`nil.destroy` → NoMethodError → 500 instead of 404; `params[:embeddable_host]` missing → NoMethodError → 500; and the core feature behavior — `host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if host.category_id.blank?` and the render_json_error validation path — has zero coverage, so any regression in the category-assignment logic this PR is about lands undetected.

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, both `update` and `destroy` fetch with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` (see new file `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`). If no record is found, `host` is `nil`, so `save_host(nil)` will call `host.host = ...` and `destroy` will call `nil.destroy`, raising `NoMethodError` and producing a 500 instead of a 404. Additionally, `save_host` assumes `params[:embeddable_host]` exists (`params[:embeddable_host][:host]`), so a missing/invalid payload will also raise `NoMethodError` (500). The finding’s point about the specs not exercising requests is also supported: the only new controller specs are inheritance checks and do not cover these paths.
